title: Minimum ASCII Delete Sum for Two Strings
goal: Delete characters from two strings at minimum ASCII cost until the strings are equal.
strategy: DP over prefix pairs either keeps matching final characters for free or deletes one final character and pays its ASCII value. Empty-prefix borders accumulate all necessary deletions.
